# final-crontab-fragment.txt — every remaining ported job, ready for install-crontab-fragment.sh
#
# Written 2026-10-11 by the manager session, after the ssh door was restored. It gathers, in one
# file, what four workstreams had proved but could not install because they lost access to the box:
#   134 (guards, retention, deadman, journal), 135 (freshness monitors), 138 (comms/Dialpad ingestion).
# Workstream 139's three lines are ALREADY in root's crontab and are deliberately not repeated here.
#
# Every wrapped line is `cron-wrap.sh <name> <base64-of-command>`; the name is the office job's name
# wherever the job is the same job, so /root/.cron-status/runs.tsv keeps reading true. The
# installer verifies each payload decodes before it writes anything.
#
# NOT in this file, on purpose: anything that would send a message (nothing here transmits), anything
# that needs a file that is still only on the office box, and the five systemd timers (workstream 137
# installed some as units).
SHELL=/bin/bash
PATH=/usr/local/sbin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/sbin:/usr/bin:/sbin:/bin
